additional_info.subject: RE: ID0431520-DC/Si-D/BE- [MP / S8 170002463] Charger location CRM:02832000076
additional_info.body:
Dear Chloë D'hose,
We have checked the charger on SCB and found that it is currently offline. Unfortunately, we are unable to perform any further actions remotely without an active SCB connection.As a next step, we recommend performing a hard reset via the OCPP server, provided the charger is connected through OCPP. If a remote reset is not possible, a local reboot will be necessary to restore connectivity.
Should the charger remain offline after these steps, we will need to arrange a site visit to inspect the router settings and assess the network signal strength. Please let us know if you require further assistance.
With best regards,
E Mobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
